cases.explicit_source:
from "dialects/hlo.tepl" import HLO as hlo;
use hlo::{add, mul, negate, subtract, zero_like, transpose, broadcast,
        reduce_sum, reverse, slice, dot};

rule dot_associate {
    X: [M, K]
    Y: [K, N]
    Z: [N, P]
    (attr_outer: dot (attr_inner: dot X Y) Z) => (dot[attr_inner.attrs] X (dot[attr_outer.attrs] Y Z))
    where { attr_inner.attrs.lhs_batching_dimensions == []
         && attr_inner.attrs.rhs_batching_dimensions == []
         && attr_inner.attrs.lhs_contracting_dimensions == [1]
         && attr_inner.attrs.rhs_contracting_dimensions == [0]
         && attr_outer.attrs.lhs_batching_dimensions == []
         && attr_outer.attrs.rhs_batching_dimensions == []
         && attr_outer.attrs.lhs_contracting_dimensions == [1]
         && attr_outer.attrs.rhs_contracting_dimensions == [0] }
}
